summary: Deckers Outdoor Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a First Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement, entered into on August 27, 2026. The amendment increases the unsecured revolving credit facility commitments to $500 million, extends the maturity date to August 27, 2031, and releases Deckers Benelux B.V. as a borrower. Interest rates are based on Term SOFR, EURIBOR, CORRA, Daily Simple RFR, or adjusted base rate plus margins ranging from 1.00% to 1.50% (SOFR-based) or 0.00% to 0.50% (base rate), with commitment fees reduced. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are involved. The filing is solely a material definitive agreement and direct financial obligation update.
